verdict.rationale: Porkbun's llms.txt documents a programmatic availability check with pricing across hundreds of TLDs that requires no auth, and the register flow's dryRun pre-flight also covers availability, so code or agents can call it directly. Nothing in the pack documents rate limits for the check endpoint, which is an explicit part of the story. The only evidence is a one-line vendor summary, with no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented rate limits for availability checks, detailed endpoint reference for the check/search call, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check domain availability programmatically — a documented check/search API my code or agent can call with clear rate limits

citations.quote: Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
Pass dryRun: true to run every pre-flight check (availability, price match, eligibility, funds, spend limit) without charging or creating anything
Every real path is mirrored under `/mock`
